arguments.sql:
WITH activity AS (
    SELECT
        ym.CustomerID,
        COUNT(*) AS monthly_rows,
        COUNT(ym.Consumption) AS recorded_months,
        MAX(ym.Consumption > 0) AS has_positive_month,
        MIN(ym.Consumption) AS min_consumption,
        MIN(ym.Date) AS first_month,
        MAX(ym.Date) AS last_month
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    WHERE ym.Date >= '201301' AND ym.Date < '201401'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
)
SELECT
    c.Segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customers,
    COUNT(a.CustomerID) AS customers_with_monthly_rows,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN a.recorded_months > 0 THEN 1 END) AS customers_with_recorded_amount,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN a.has_positive_month = 1 THEN 1 END) AS customers_with_positive_amount,
    SUM(a.monthly_rows - a.recorded_months) AS null_months,
    MIN(a.min_consumption) AS min_consumption,
    MIN(a.first_month) AS first_month,
    MAX(a.last_month) AS last_month
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN activity AS a ON a.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment

WITH customers_with_fuel AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ym.CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    WHERE ym.Date >= '201301'
      AND ym.Date < '201401'
      AND ym.Consumption IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    c.Segment,
    COUNT(f.CustomerID) AS CustomersConsumedFuel2013
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN customers_with_fuel AS f ON f.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
LIMIT -1
